display_name: 10类 PAMF 分支原型温度源域内部开发试验
description: 从零训练三组相同划分的 Hybrid＋分支原型；仅在源 L 内部开发集选温度。

data.dataset: ManyRx ten-class, previously validated original roles

roles.L_s: 6533 original; deterministic per-class split 5228 train / 1305 dev

data.train_ratio: source L split 80/20 by class with seed 20261112

permissions.query_use: no target access in this pilot
permissions.claim_scope: Source-domain pilot; historical target tests exposed; no performance claim on targets

checkpoint.initialization: scratch for each candidate, own E20/E30/E50
sources: historical same-contract E20 only for operational no-update smoke, never initialization
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: fresh own-source trajectory; smoke checkpoint excluded from training and selection
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50; source L_dev clean and physical accuracy equally weighted

expected_artifacts: three held-out source L clean and simulated-physical results
fixed source-only selection and promotion decision

dimensions: clean and fixed source simulated practical

rows.method: Hybrid plus branch prototype, prototype temperature 0.1
rows.seed_notes: Internal L split seed in data; support/evaluation seeds not applicable; simulated channel uses fixed epoch and step.
rows.scenario: source clean and source simulated low suburban, mid urban, low urban

rows.method: Hybrid plus branch prototype, prototype temperature 0.2
rows.seed_notes: Internal L split seed in data; support/evaluation seeds not applicable; simulated channel uses fixed epoch and step.
rows.scenario: source clean and source simulated low suburban, mid urban, low urban

rows.method: Hybrid plus branch prototype, prototype temperature 0.4
rows.seed_notes: Internal L split seed in data; support/evaluation seeds not applicable; simulated channel uses fixed epoch and step.
rows.scenario: source clean and source simulated low suburban, mid urban, low urban

notes: All temperatures use the same internal L split. U truth, target and query remain inaccessible.
At least 0.25 percentage point source-development mean improvement versus temperature 0.2 is required for a separate multi-seed stage.
No target predictions in this source-only pilot. Selected candidates require full-L retraining and independent truth-last target evaluation.
Previous target scores motivated the overall research; resulting target reuse is exploratory, not an independent blind confirmation.
